items.title: A study of Astegolimab for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) was stopped early

items.title: A study of BLU-5937 for Cough was stopped early
items.summary: Bellus Health Inc. - a GSK company ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 1,019 people. The study team’s reason: “The study has been terminated due to the decision to cease further development of camlipixant in refractory chronic cough (RCC), based on the results of the Phase 3 program”. The registry lists its end date as 2 Sep 2026.
